summary: OFS Capital Corporation filed an 8-K on August 28, 2026, announcing a partial redemption of its 7.50% Notes due 2028. The company will redeem $20 million of the $69 million outstanding principal on September 29, 2026, at par plus accrued interest. The redemption is pursuant to the indenture's optional redemption provisions. This is a routine debt management action by the issuer, not a special situation. There is no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or shareholder return involved. The redemption reduces debt and interest expense, but does not constitute a capital return event in the context of special situations. Watch for continued debt management or potential refinancing, but no risk-arb angle exists.
